# fptcloud_backup_native_volume_backup (Resource)

Runs a Backup Native volume backup job once, outside its schedule, the same operation as "Start backup" in the portal. Applying the resource checks the job's status, starts the run and waits for it to end. A job that is still running a backup, a restore or a change fails the apply at once, without starting a run. Destroying the resource only removes it from state. Change a value in `triggers` to run the backup again. A failed run fails the apply and leaves the resource tainted, so the next apply runs it again. A job with one volume may be retried by the backend after a failed run. When the job stays in `pending`, the apply runs out its timeout; only a later run or the backend clears that state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Runs fptcloud_backup_native_volume_job.data once and waits for the run to end.
# Change backup_run (for example to a date) to run the backup again.
resource "fptcloud_backup_native_volume_backup" "data" {
  vpc_id   = var.vpc_id
  job_id   = fptcloud_backup_native_volume_job.data.id
  triggers = { run = var.backup_run }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_id` (String) ID of the backup job to run, the `id` of a `fptcloud_backup_native_volume_job`.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC that owns the backup job.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that run the backup again when they change. Use it to run the same job again, which no other argument can express because every other argument stays equal.

### Read-Only

- `finished_at` (String) When the provider saw the run end, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `started_at` (String) When the provider started the run, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `status` (String) The job's status when the run ended, `Success` or `success` after a successful apply.
